title: Carousel
purpose: Present a controlled sequence of related content when showing all items at once would be impractical or would weaken the intended hierarchy.

composition.role: named region containing slides and controls

composition.semantics: visible text and optional polite live status
buttons or tabs when full tab contract is implemented

variants.content_rail: multiple cards may be visible in a horizontal scroll container
variants.media_gallery: one primary medium plus direct slide picker

layout.focal_point: Media cropping may adapt by viewport, but focal points and text-safe areas must remain intentional.

previous_next.focus_after_activation: focus remains on the activated control
previous_next.disabled_or_wrap: must be explicitly decided; do not infer infinite wrapping

picker.focus_after_activation: remains on picker unless task explicitly requires moving it

if_enabled: stop when keyboard focus enters the carousel
do not resume automatically after focus-triggered pause
stop on pointer hover where relevant

announcements.user_initiated_single_slide_change: short polite position update when useful
announcements.automatic_change: must never silently replace the context for assistive-technology users

behavior.touch_and_scroll: Swipe/native scrolling may supplement controls but must not be the only interaction path.

responsive.strategy: preserve sequence and control semantics while visible slide count, crop and spacing adapt

accessibility.inactive_single_slide_content: remove from interaction and accessibility tree, e.g. native hidden
accessibility.control_names: Previous/next/picker controls have understandable accessible names.

performance.media: use responsive sources appropriate to rendered size
performance.lazy_loading: non-initial media may load lazily when doing so does not break interaction

constraints: Do not add autoplay unless the requirement explicitly asks for it.
Do not make swipe or drag the only way to navigate.
Do not move keyboard focus merely because the visible slide changed.
Do not leave interactive content from visually hidden single-slide panels keyboard reachable.
Do not implement ordinary previous/next controls as links.
Do not use dramatic motion when prefers-reduced-motion requests reduced motion.
Before using a carousel, consider whether a visible list or grid communicates the content better.

agent_contract.instruction: Reconstruct from this Build DNA rather than copying reference HTML. Ask for missing carousel decisions such as wrapping, visible count or autoplay instead of inventing them.
agent_contract.when_conflicting: Purpose, constraints, behavior and accessibility override visual resemblance.
agent_contract.output_expectation: Production-appropriate carousel code for the requested stack plus explicitly listed unresolved interaction decisions.

request_examples.intent: Build a generic Carousel from the shared contract.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir ein Carousel nach https://blame76.github.io/how-to-web/elements/interactive/carousel/ und nutze die Build DNA als Rekonstruktionsvertrag.

request_examples.intent: Build the documented full-bleed Editorial / Visual Story.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir die Variante "Editorial / Visual Story" nach. Nutze die Full-Bleed-Demo als visuelle Richtung und die Build DNA als normativen Vertrag.

request_examples.intent: Build the documented multi-card Content Rail.
request_examples.prompt: Baue mir die Variante "Content Rail" nach. Mehrere Cards dürfen sichtbar sein; bewahre Tastatur-, Scroll- und Fokusregeln.
Baue mir die Variante "Media Gallery" nach. Großes Medium plus direkte Auswahl; bewahre aktiven Zustand und Accessibility.

request_examples.intent: Adapt the Carousel contract to an existing stack.
request_examples.prompt: Übertrage das how-to-web Carousel in mein bestehendes Projekt. Nutze vorhandene Tokens und Komponenten und erfinde keine Autoplay-, Fokus- oder Navigationsregeln.

acceptance: Every carousel can be fully operated with keyboard without requiring hover, swipe or drag.
Previous and next controls are native buttons with understandable names.
Using previous/next does not unexpectedly move keyboard focus.
Single-slide variants remove inactive interactive slide content from keyboard and accessibility interaction.
The current slide or viewport position is understandable where the variant needs explicit orientation.
No autoplay occurs unless explicitly configured.
If autoplay is configured, stop/start and focus-pause behavior are implemented.
The sequence remains usable at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.
The host page does not gain unintended horizontal overflow.

examples.note: Full-bleed gadget editorial story; no autoplay.
Multi-card horizontal rail with native scroll and scroll snap.
